basis.governing_question: Why did export margins fall in 2025 at Vinhos do Douro Lda?

phases.name: Diagnostic
phases.objective_one_line: Establish why export margins fell in 2025, tracing the drivers through pricing by export market and distributor terms.

gate.label: Final readout
gate.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 export margin decline?

workstreams.name: Pricing by export market
workstreams.answers: How did realized prices and margins by export market change in 2025, and which markets explain the fall?
activities: Extract export sales and cost data by market and year
Interview the people who set export prices in each market
Build a 2025 margin bridge by export market

workstreams.name: Distributor terms
workstreams.answers: How do distributor terms differ across export markets, and what share of the 2025 margin decline do they explain?
activities: Review distributor contracts and terms by export market
Interview the people who manage distributor relationships
Combine both sets of findings into one margin explanation

deliverables.name: Distributor terms comparison by export market
Findings on the 2025 export margin decline

events.label: Kick-off
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director confirm scope, team and calendar for the diagnostic?
agenda: Present the diagnostic objective and the 2025 export margin question
Review the two workstreams and the week 5 and week 8 deliverables
Confirm team, data access and meeting calendar

events.label: Workshop: first findings
events.purpose: Review first findings on margin drivers
events.decision: Which drivers of the margin decline should the final findings detail further?
agenda: Present the 2025 export margin bridge by market
Review distributor terms by export market against the bridge
Discuss the drivers of the margin decline and what to detail next

events.label: Final readout
events.purpose: Close the diagnostic and accept the findings
events.decision: Do the CEO and Export Director accept the findings on the 2025 export margin decline?
agenda: Present the findings on the 2025 export margin decline
Review how the findings address the workshop input
Decide whether the findings are accepted

architect_notes: Engagement type is assumed assessment from the phrase 'a quick diagnostic'; confirm it before quoting, because an implementation scope would add phases.
Performance improvement archetype fits closest; its Implementation phase is dropped because the engagement is assessment only, leaving one Diagnostic phase.
The brief names no stages, so all eight weeks form one Diagnostic phase; confirm the client wants no later phase after the findings.
